justification: Critical: changes which Inner West LEP 2022 rules /api/provisions/for-property serves for a property (site-specific rules withheld off their land), adds a column the route selects (migration 109, applied), and writes conditions to 292 production rows.

pre_impl.existing_data: 554 served Inner West LEP 2022 rows; 67 of 88 clauses recorded scope_declined and served to ALL. Production for-property with former_council=inner_west returned 538 IW LEP rows for any lot (measured 2026-10-11); with former_council=Leichhardt it returned 0 (the document filter excludes the LEP).
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: DQ-140 read 0 because it counted undecided keys; a declined key is decided but still served everywhere. Schedule 1 continuation rows carry no item number and one (23689) carries clause 7.4's heading, so headings alone cannot place them.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Reuses the land_application pattern (encode on the caller, decode+decide in the route) from lib/dcp-land-application.ts and the layer list nsw-planning-portal.ts already fetches; no new portal call.
pre_impl.external_source_error: Portal heritage items are I269/I1123 while the OCR'd Schedule 5 table reads 1269/11123; mapped 1->I. Cl 6.26 names APU '46' for Trafalgar St lots, but the portal returns APU 46 on 10 Norton St too, so 6.26 matches every APU-46 lot -- flagged, not guessed around.
pre_impl.frontend_type: Rows gain v2_land_condition (jsonb object or null) and kept rows land_status 'match'|'unconfirmed' plus land_note; PageGroupedProvisions renders the unconfirmed badge.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: Before: cl 6.17 (168 Norton St seniors housing) and every Schedule 1 site's extra uses shown on any Inner West lot reached with former_council=inner_west. Failure of the new path is visible: no portal answer -> rules kept with 'Could not confirm this land'.

falsifiable_check.command: python scripts/dq_probe_live.py --id DQ-140 ; python -m pytest tests/test_inner_west_lep_land.py -q ; cd frontend-nextjs && npx jest __tests__/api/lep-land-condition.test.ts
falsifiable_check.fails_when: A served land-gated row has no land condition; or 10 Norton St is served 6.17 / item 45 or misses item 46, 6.14, 6.15; or 45 Victoria Rd misses 6.21 or is served item 46.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: DQ-140 read 292 on 2026-10-11 after migration 109 and before the write; 0 after scripts/apply_iw_lep_land_conditions.py --apply wrote 292 rows.

functions.name: row_conditions
functions.input: all current rows of one IW LEP document
functions.output: a dict mapping each row id to the land condition (layer, labels, zones, verified, source) it must satisfy
functions.if_none: a Schedule 1 row whose item cannot be read gets layer None -> shown as unconfirmed

functions.name: clause_condition
functions.input: one land-gated clause key from LAND_GATED_CLAUSES, such as '6.21' or '7.3'
functions.output: its condition from the clause's quoted words or a quoted override
functions.if_none: raises ValueError -- a clause cannot silently lack a condition

functions.name: applyLandConditions
functions.input: the provision rows of one layer and the lot's LandFacts decoded from the land_facts query value, or null
functions.output: the rows to serve, each land-limited one tagged land_status, plus counts of rows withheld and unconfirmed
functions.if_none: facts null -> nothing withheld, every land-limited row marked unconfirmed

functions.name: getFormerCouncilForPoint
functions.input: the property's latitude and longitude in WGS84, from the portal's address geometry
functions.output: the capitalised former council stored on the Inner West lot under that point, or null when there is none
functions.if_none: null keeps the suburb/postcode answer; a failed query also returns null and is logged

values.source: each clause's own words in enrichment/config/inner_west_lep_config.py scope_evidence (checked verbatim against legislation.nsw.gov.au 2026-10-10)
values.if_missing: DQ-140 counts the row; route serves it with no gate

queries.purpose: read IW LEP rows to build conditions
former council of the lot under the property point
queries.where_clause: WHERE former_council IS NOT NULL AND ST_Contains(geom, point)

break_it.scenario: Portal down / caller does not pass land_facts
break_it.what_happens: Rows kept, marked 'Could not confirm this land'
break_it.how: decideLandCondition returns unconfirmed when facts is null
break_it.repro: curl '/api/provisions/for-property?lga=Inner%20West&zone=E1&former_council=inner_west' with no land_facts; every land-limited row returns land_status unconfirmed

break_it.scenario: The land_facts query value is truncated or is not valid JSON at all
break_it.what_happens: Decoded as null -> unconfirmed, never a match

break_it.scenario: A rule's layer is one the portal was never seen returning for any lot
break_it.what_happens: The rule stays on the page, marked could not confirm this land, and is never withheld

break_it.scenario: The new route code is deployed to Vercel before migration 109 reaches the database
break_it.what_happens: Every provisions request fails with a column-does-not-exist SQL error, loudly and visibly
break_it.how: migration 109 applied to production 2026-10-11 before merge
break_it.repro: SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='regulatory_provisions' AND column_name='v2_land_condition' -- returns one row (applied 2026-10-11)

break_it.scenario: Inner West LEP rows are re-extracted later and come back without their land conditions
break_it.what_happens: The DQ-140 probe rises above 0 and the ledger check, declared fixed, turns red
break_it.how: probe in the ledger, declared open until 0

break_it.scenario: A clause's map label is shared with other land, as APU 46 is for cl 6.26 and Schedule 1 item 46
break_it.what_happens: A label hit returns unconfirmed, so 6.26 shows with could not confirm this land on APU-46 lots and nowhere else

break_it.scenario: The suburb or postcode mapping names the wrong former council, as for St Peters, Enmore and Lewisham
break_it.what_happens: The lot's stored former council overrides it, so the property gets its own council's DCP rules
break_it.how: lot lookup runs after the mapping in property-data.ts; measured 15 of 16 real lots right, 16th has none and keeps the mapping

post_merge.manual_verify: Already applied 2026-10-11: migration 109 and 292 condition rows (backup data/db_rollback_backups/regulatory_provisions_pre_iw_land_condition_2026-10-11_0904.csv). DQ-140 reads 0. Nothing further to run.

real_layer_exempt.scripts/apply_iw_lep_land_conditions.py: Writer for one column on 292 rows; dry run by default, backup + count check + rollback on mismatch with --apply.
